headline: EIA confirms crude stocks +17.4mb (wk Aug 7) vs -1.4mb forecast, largest weekly build since early 2023
gist: First run of the day, covering overnight developments. headline: Trump: US has "total control" of Hormuz and "will keep it"; Iran unmoved, transits at 1-week low
gist: Fresh overnight escalation not previously reported: Trump posted late Aug 12 that the US has "total control" over the Strait of Hormuz, calling the naval blockade a "wall of steel" and saying "I THINK WE WILL KEEP IT!" -- notably tougher rhetoric than the prior "Pakistan close to a deal"/Oman-mediated "final stages" framing covered in earlier briefs. Iran continues asserting it controls the waterway and intends to impose a toll system; Hormuz ship transits fell to a one-week low overnight. Per Lloyd's List Intelligence, two vessels transiting the Omani alternate route have been struck since Aug 1 plus one attempted attack, confirming the elevated attack tempo is ongoing rather than isolated (consistent with, not distinct from, the already-covered Houthi/Egyptian-ship fatality story). This risk premium is currently being outweighed by the EIA inventory shock (see companion item) -- WTI/Brent both lower overnight despite the rhetoric. Source: Bloomberg/Al Jazeera/Lloyd's List Intelligence. Sent with cards (bias board, news, WTI chart).
